# This models wire replay only; actual durable replay has separate server tests.
skygo --json run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1 --request-id stable
cp stdout first.json
data-peer drift
skygo --json run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1 --request-id stable
cp stdout replay.json
cmp first.json replay.json
data-wire 0 stable aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1
data-wire 1 stable aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1
# Neither an implicit domain nor an automatically generated ID permits a probe.
! skygo run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-id stable
stderr 'target'
! skygo run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1
stderr 'target'
calls SubmitDataJob 2
! skygo run --remote-data -f changed.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1 --request-id stable
stderr 'conflict|already_exists'
! skygo run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1 --request-id new-id
stderr 'current target unavailable|failed_precondition'
data-wire 3 new-id aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1
calls SubmitDataJob 4
calls PlanTask 0
calls BeginArtifactUpload 0
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 0
calls SubmitJob 0
calls SubmitRetainedJob 0
calls SubmitRetryJob 0

-- mounts.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- changed.yaml --
argv: [echo, changed]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true
